prompt:
Goal: Create a cinematic biographical movie-poster collage celebrating LEONARDO, with the subtitle A LIFE IN ROLES, styled like an awards-season retrospective poster.

Canvas: Landscape 4:3 poster, warm cream parchment background with subtle vignette, high-resolution photorealistic composite, dramatic studio lighting, sepia-gold color grade, sharp faces, soft feathered collage edges.

Layout: Place one enormous close-up side-profile portrait of the actor dominating the right-center, facing right, cropped from forehead to chin with detailed skin texture and blue-green eye. On the left half, build a layered collage of exactly 9 smaller role portraits around him, all depicting the same man at different ages and costumes: 1) a stern airline pilot in a navy cap at upper left, 2) a young man shouting into a vintage microphone at upper center-left, 3) a blond 1990s youth in a tan jacket at mid-left, 4) a serious man in a blue shirt behind the center group, 5) a neatly dressed man in a pale shirt at mid-center, 6) a dark-suited intense man at lower left, 7) a blond brooding man in a dark jacket at lower center-left, 8) a tuxedoed millionaire holding a coupe glass of champagne at lower center, and 9) a rugged bearded frontiersman with facial wounds and fur clothing at lower right of the collage.

Props: Add exactly 3 prominent symbolic props in the lower-left foreground: 1) an antique pocket watch with chain, 2) a blood-splattered axe angled diagonally near the bottom center-left, and 3) red blood splatter stains along the bottom-left edge. Include a vintage chrome microphone near the shouting portrait.

Typography: At the top right, large condensed bold black title text: LEONARDO. Directly beneath it, smaller bold uppercase subtitle: A LIFE IN ROLES. On the right side under the subtitle, include a narrow vertical filmography timeline made of tiny black text entries with bracket marks and era labels; the text may be partially nonsensical but should resemble a chronological list. Include exactly 4 vertical era labels on the far right: YOUTH 1990s, ASCENT 2000s, EXCESS 2010s, SURVIVAL 2020s.

Bottom text: Centered near the bottom, add the slogan in bold uppercase: SAME MAN. ENDLESS TRUTHS.. Under it, add a small handwritten signature reading "Leonardo DiCaprio". At lower right, add the quote in uppercase: HE DOESN'T JUST PLAY CHARACTERS. HE HOLDS UP A MIRROR TO THE CENTURY.. Beneath the quote, include exactly 2 laurel award badges: one labeled "ACADEMY AWARD WINNER" and one labeled "A CAREER FOR THE AGES".

Style constraints: Make it look like a polished Hollywood retrospective poster, not a flat infographic. Use realistic actor likeness, seamless photomontage blending, warm highlights, deep shadows, crisp black typography, and no visible watermark or border. Keep the exact count of 10 total portraits including the large profile and 9 smaller role portraits, 3 foreground props, 4 era labels, and 2 laurel badges.

promptZh:
目标：创作一张电影传记风格的拼贴海报，以庆祝 LEONARDO，副标题为 A LIFE IN ROLES，呈现出颁奖季回顾海报的质感。

画布：4:3 横向海报，暖色调奶油色羊皮纸背景，带有细腻的晕影，高分辨率写实合成，戏剧性的摄影棚灯光，棕褐色与金色调，面部清晰，拼贴边缘柔和羽化。

布局：在右中位置放置一张巨大的演员侧脸特写，面朝右侧，从额头到下巴裁剪，展现细腻的皮肤纹理和蓝绿色眼睛。在左半部分，围绕他构建一个由 9 个较小角色肖像组成的层叠拼贴，所有肖像均描绘同一名男子在不同年龄和服装下的形象：1) 左上角戴着海军帽的严厉飞行员，2) 左上方对着复古麦克风大喊的年轻人，3) 左中位置穿着棕褐色夹克的 90 年代金发青年，4) 中间群体后方穿着蓝色衬衫的严肃男子，5) 中间位置穿着浅色衬衫的整洁男子，6) 左下角穿着深色西装、神情紧张的男子，7) 左下中位置穿着深色夹克、神情忧郁的金发男子，8) 下方中间拿着香槟杯的西装革履的百万富翁，以及 9) 拼贴画右下角穿着毛皮服装、面部带有伤痕的粗犷胡须边疆开拓者。

道具：在左下角前景添加 3 个醒目的象征性道具：1) 一块带链条的古董怀表，2) 一把斜放在左下方的带血斧头，以及 3) 沿左下边缘分布的红色血迹。在呐喊的肖像旁加入一个复古镀铬麦克风。

排版：在右上角，使用大型压缩粗体黑色标题文字：LEONARDO。在其正下方，使用较小的粗体大写副标题：A LIFE IN ROLES。在副标题下方的右侧，包含一个狭窄的垂直电影作品时间线，由带有括号标记和时代标签的细小黑色文字组成；文字内容可以是无意义的，但应呈现出时间列表的视觉效果。在最右侧包含 4 个垂直时代标签：YOUTH 1990s（90 年代青春）、ASCENT 2000s（2000 年代崛起）、EXCESS 2010s（2010 年代繁盛）、SURVIVAL 2020s（2020 年代生存）。

底部文字：在底部中心，添加粗体大写标语：SAME MAN. ENDLESS TRUTHS.。在其下方，添加一行手写签名“Leonardo DiCaprio”。在右下角，添加大写引言：HE DOESN'T JUST PLAY CHARACTERS. HE HOLDS UP A MIRROR TO THE CENTURY.。在引言下方，包含 2 个月桂花环奖项徽章：一个标注为“ACADEMY AWARD WINNER”（奥斯卡金像奖得主），另一个标注为“A CAREER FOR THE AGES”（跨时代的职业生涯）。

风格限制：使其看起来像一张精致的好莱坞回顾海报，而非扁平的信息图。使用逼真的演员肖像，无缝的图片合成，暖色高光，深邃阴影，清晰的黑色字体，且无可见的水印或边框。严格保持总计 10 个肖像（包括大侧脸和 9 个小角色肖像）、3 个前景道具、4 个时代标签和 2 个月桂花环徽章的数量。
